_comment: Enterprise deployment policy. Copy to managed-config.json and deploy machine-wide: macOS /Library/Application Support/Métis/managed-config.json, Windows %ProgramData%\Métis\managed-config.json. These paths must match exactly — the app reads only this location (adminManagedConfigPath in src/main/win-security.ts); a policy dropped anywhere else is silently ignored, so the fleet keeps running unmanaged with no error. Replace placeholder IDs and URLs before rollout.
_comment_license: licenseGateEnabled is deliberately absent (MQA-068). Device licensing is COMPILED OFF in the shipped app — App.tsx's LICENSE_ENFORCEMENT and Settings.tsx's LICENSE_UI_ENABLED both gate it, so setting this key here activates nothing, shows no activation screen, and runs no revocation heartbeat. It shipped here set-and-locked, which read as a working policy and could not be one. Add it back only in the same change that flips both constants and re-verifies activation end to end.
_comment_egress: egressAllowlist restricts every outbound host on both network stacks (main-process fetch and the Chromium session). Hostnames only; *.example.com covers subdomains; loopback is always allowed. Remove the key for no restriction. The full host list per feature is in docs/NETWORK-EGRESS.md. This example matches allowedProviders above plus sign-in, calendar, and updates.
_comment_updates: updateFeedUrl points electron-updater at an internally hosted generic feed (latest.yml + installer + blockmap) instead of the public GitHub releases repo. Admin (machine) policy only; must be https. Remove the key to use the built-in feed. disableAutoUpdate: true freezes updates entirely.
